arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT, cozy farm against zombies.
Primary request: A046 spitter identity candidate1, ONE whole standing zombie, facing WEST/LEFT.
Input images: Image1 reference-sheet is camera, materials and outline style; Image2 walker master is same-world enemy colour/density/camera, NOT the character to copy; Image3 approved32px farmer is native scale reference.
Style/medium: coherent handcrafted pixel art with deliberate large clusters, coloured outlines, restrained texture, readable material planes and simple bold forms.
Composition/framing: orthographic three-quarter top-down on rectangulargrid, native64x48 with groundpivot(32,44); visible body about22wide x29tall, lowestrow43. Standing enemy a little shorter than32px farmer. Complete unclipped body, grounded feet centred.
Lighting: neutral daytime upper-left highlights, darker undersides; runtime supplies night.
Palette: rot-green skin, sickly yellow-green throat sac, muted torn work shirt, brown boots, violet-grey shadow. Pale cloudy eye bone/bone_dark, no emission.
WALKER family adapted: The spitter, a GAUNT HUNCHED zombie with an enormous swollen THROAT SAC and puffed cheeks. Sac grows directly from lowerface/neck, broad bulge around throat, NOT a ball held in hand. Thin arms, tattered cloth, stooped spit-ready stance, west-facing muzzle. Sac is centralidentity and visible at29pixels; silhouette differs from ordinarywalker, thinrunner, broadtank and breaker. Make sac protrude below jaw to the west, hunched upperback and slim legs.
Background TRUE transparent, alpha0 outside sharp solidpixel edges. No globs/projectiles, weapons, extra limbs, ground shadow, grass, ground patch, glow, mist, halos, labels, text or UI.
Avoid painting/vector/3D/antialiasing/blur/gradient/randomspeckle/thickblackboxes/diamondtiles/tiny details. Bold low-resolution anatomy and clean outlines; no cute big mascot head.
